format: html

## APIs Checkpoint

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
library(DiagrammeR)

grViz("
digraph APIs {
  graph [rankdir = TB, fontsize = 12]
  
  # Global node settings - Force black text and a clean font
  node [fontname = Helvetica, fontcolor = black]
  
  # Main topic
  main [label = 'APIs & URLs', shape = box, style = filled, fillcolor = '#ADD8E6', fontsize = 14]
  
  # Main branches
  json_branch [label = 'JSON', shape = box, style = filled, fillcolor = '#90EE90']
  url_branch [label = 'URL Structure', shape = box, style = filled, fillcolor = '#90EE90']
  urltools_branch [label = 'urltools Functions', shape = box, style = filled, fillcolor = '#90EE90']
  
  main -> json_branch
  main -> url_branch
  main -> urltools_branch
  
  # JSON branch
  json_def [label = 'Format for organizing\\ndata from APIs', shape = ellipse]
  json_struct [label = 'JSON Structure', shape = box, style = filled, fillcolor = '#FFFFE0']
  json_to_r [label = 'Convert to R', shape = box, style = filled, fillcolor = '#FFFFE0']
  
  json_branch -> json_def
  json_branch -> json_struct
  json_branch -> json_to_r
  
  # JSON structure
  parent_elem [label = 'Parent elements:\\nkey-value pairs', shape = ellipse]
  curly_braces [label = '{...} = one row\\nof data', shape = ellipse]
  brackets [label = '[...] = array/list\\nof objects', shape = ellipse]
  
  json_struct -> parent_elem
  json_struct -> curly_braces
  json_struct -> brackets
  
  # JSON to R conversion
  named_list [label = 'Named list with\\n2+ elements', shape = ellipse]
  nested_df [label = 'Nested data frame\\n(list column)', shape = ellipse]
  
  json_to_r -> named_list
  json_to_r -> nested_df
  
  # URL Structure branch
  url_scheme [label = 'Scheme:\\nhttps://', shape = ellipse]
  url_host [label = 'Host Address:\\nwww.example.com', shape = ellipse]
  url_path [label = 'File Path:\\n/folder/file.htm', shape = ellipse]
  url_fragment [label = 'Fragment:\\n#top', shape = ellipse]
  url_query [label = 'Query:\\nsearchTerm=HTML', shape = ellipse]
  
  url_branch -> url_scheme
  url_branch -> url_host
  url_branch -> url_path
  url_branch -> url_fragment
  url_branch -> url_query
  
  # urltools functions
  url_encode [label = 'url_encode():\\nstring to %encoded URL', shape = ellipse]
  url_decode [label = 'url_decode():\\n%encoded URL to string', shape = ellipse]
  param_set [label = 'param_set():\\nadd query to URL', shape = ellipse]
  
  urltools_branch -> url_encode
  urltools_branch -> url_decode
  urltools_branch -> param_set
}
")
```
